Textarea

Textarea is a multi-line text input control for collecting longer user input such as messages, descriptions, and comments.

Basic Textarea

A standard textarea with rows configuration.

HTML 
<textarea class="zak-textarea" rows="4" placeholder="Type your message here..."></textarea>

Auto-resize

Textarea that grows with content using the .zak-textarea-auto class.

This textarea grows as you type more content.
HTML 
<textarea class="zak-textarea zak-textarea-auto" rows="2" placeholder="Start typing..."></textarea>

With Character Count

Display a live character count using JavaScript.

0/150
HTML + JS 
<textarea id="bio" class="zak-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="150"
  oninput="document.getElementById('count').textContent = this.value.length + '/150'">
</textarea>
<span class="zak-form-text" id="count">0/150</span>

Sizes

Textareas come in three sizes.

HTML 
<textarea class="zak-textarea zak-textarea-sm" rows="2"></textarea>
<textarea class="zak-textarea" rows="3"></textarea>
<textarea class="zak-textarea zak-textarea-lg" rows="4"></textarea>

Disabled & Read-only

Disable or lock textareas.

HTML 
<textarea class="zak-textarea" rows="3" disabled>Cannot edit this.</textarea>
<textarea class="zak-textarea" rows="3" readonly>Can select, cannot edit.</textarea>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-textareaBase textarea styling
.zak-textarea-smSmall size
.zak-textarea-lgLarge size
.zak-textarea-autoAuto-resize on content change

Accessibility

  • Always use a <label> associated with the textarea via for/id.
  • Provide a placeholder only as a hint, not as a label replacement.
  • Set rows to give users a visual cue about expected content length.
  • Use maxlength when there is a character limit.
  • Announce character count changes to screen readers with aria-live regions.
